title: 第35章 大圣来了
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 财神爷、土地公、月老、电母……群里开始疯狂@齐天大圣。土地公：【@齐天大圣 别躲了，知道你在线！】月老：【悟空，再不出来我用红线打个死结！】电母：【我直接给你花果山停电信不信？】温栩栩盯着屏幕，看群里这么热闹，心里忽然感觉暖暖的。同时，她的好奇心也被勾了起来。从来没在群里露过面的齐天大圣孙悟空，会不会理会自已这只小虾米呢？土地公：【这猴子玩心重，平时喊他八百遍都不一定搭理人。】温栩栩已经做好了等半小时的准备——结果下一秒。一条来自“齐天大圣”的语音弹了出来。温栩栩指尖颤抖着点开。一个带着金属质感、又痞又野的声音炸响在卧室里：【俺老孙来也！！！】这声音中气十足！温栩栩手机差点吓飞。这声音……真的好像西游记里那个大圣啊！又拽又欠揍，还带着点“老子天下第一”的味儿。齐天大圣：【刚在蟠桃园摘桃子，没看群消息。咋了？谁欺负咱群团宠了？】温栩栩还没来得及回，齐天大圣一个金光闪闪的专属红包就砸了过来。她下意识点开——屏幕上跳出四个字：【三根猴毛】已领取。三根猴毛？在哪儿呢？温栩栩在神仙群界面按了一圈，又捧起自已的手机，仔细看了看。真的有三根猴毛！只见她原本光秃秃的透明壳背面，真的多了三根金色的猴毛。细细的，软软的，在灯光下泛着好看的光泽。哇塞，这是齐天大圣的周边嘛！！！齐天大圣：【丫头，这三根猴毛你收好了。】齐天大圣：【每用一根，就能召唤俺老孙附身一次。每次附身时间，按你们凡间算，整整一天。】温栩栩盯着那三根金灿灿的猴毛，眼睛都直了。召唤孙悟空附身？一天？她脑子里已经开始飞速运转——这要是遇到坏人，直接让大圣上身，别说几个小混混，来一车都不够打的。齐天大圣：【不过有个条件啊，附身的时候，俺老孙想干啥你得配合。比如翻个跟头、耍个金箍棒什么的，别拦着。】温栩栩手指差点把手机键盘按冒烟：【当然可以！！！】被齐天大圣附身，那是什么概念？这位可是大闹天宫的主儿！一个人单挑十万天兵天将的那种！以后出门还怕谁？她激动得在床上打了个滚，然后赶紧打字：温栩栩：【谢谢大圣！我要给您上供点啥？您想吃啥？水蜜桃？香蕉酥？我怎么给您送过去？】齐天大圣：【上供？不用整那些虚的。】温栩栩一愣，心想大圣这么客气？下一秒，消息弹出来：齐天大圣：【丫头，你现在，立刻，马上，用一根猴毛召唤我。】温栩栩：？？？大圣来的这么快。难道这就是传说中的“猴急”吗？温栩栩：【现在？】难道大圣是察觉到自已身边有什么危险了吗？！齐天大圣：【对！就现在！赶紧的！】齐天大圣：【俺老孙得亲自检查检查你身边有没有危险。我这火眼金睛，方圆百里有个风吹草动都瞒不过去！】温栩立刻正色起来：【好！】大圣不愧是大圣，执行力超绝！温栩栩按照孙悟空说的召唤方法，捏起一根金色猴毛，在掌心搓了搓。搓到掌心微微发热的那一刻——温栩栩脑袋忽然晕了一下。就一下，她像坐了趟极速电梯，眼前黑了一瞬，然后又亮了。紧接着，一股奇怪的感觉从脚底窜上来。不是难受，是……像有个什么东西钻进了身体里。但那种感觉只持续了两三秒，很快就消失了。取而代之的，是一种前所未有的——电量满格。温栩栩从床上蹦起来，原地蹦了两下，又转了个圈。浑身有使不完的劲，像刚灌了三瓶红牛。她忍不住挠了挠脸颊，又挠了挠后脑勺，然后发现自已根本停不下来——手好像有自已的想法，一直在动，好像有那个多动症一样。温栩栩赶紧开口：“大圣？大圣你来啦？”“你感知到我周围有什么危险没有？”话音刚落，脑子里响起一个又痞又野的声音：“别急，俺老孙正扫描呢。”“嗯……你隔壁那栋别墅，有人在吃夜宵，烤串还挺香。”“楼下有两只小肥猫在谈恋爱，公的那只献殷勤献了半天，母的那只压根没搭理他，还赏了他一巴掌。”……温栩栩：“……”大圣，你这火眼金睛，是不是有点太细了？大圣操控着温栩栩的身体，在三层大别墅里上蹿下跳地溜达了一圈。左看看，右看看。随后，一屁股坐在床上，翘起二郎腿，用温栩栩的脸做出一个“就这？”的表情：“丫头，你这屋儿也太空了，连根棍儿都没有，俺老孙想耍两下都找不着家伙。”温栩栩立刻狗腿道：“买！明天就买！铁的木的金的钛合金的全部都安排上！”“那你们凡人平时都玩啥？”大圣挠了挠下巴。温栩栩拿起手机晃了晃：“玩这个呀，玩手机！”大圣凑过来，盯着屏幕瞅了半天：“这就是你们用来跟天庭联系的那个小方块儿？除了在神仙群里发消息，还能干啥？”温栩栩：“能看剧、能听歌、能玩游戏——对了，群里发的那些短剧，就是用这个看的。”大圣摆摆手，一脸嫌弃：“剧？俺老孙可不爱看那个，情情爱爱的没劲，什么爽剧之类的也不够爽啊。”温栩栩一听，觉得非常有道理。大圣是谁？大闹天宫、七十二变、一个跟头十万八千里的人物。大圣的人生本身就是最顶级的爽文，看他自已的故事就够了，哪还用得着看别人编的？温栩栩忍不住脑补了一下大圣看凡间爽剧的样子——屏幕上主角在那儿喊“我要逆天”，大圣在旁边嗑着瓜子翻白眼：逆天？俺老孙把天都捅漏了。屏幕上反派在那儿装逼，大圣冷笑：就这？俺老孙一棒子能打死一打。温栩栩默默收回思绪，得出结论：大圣不看剧，是嫌弃剧情不够爽。温栩栩忽然想起什么，眼睛一亮。
content_en: God of Wealth, Earth God, Yue Lao, Lightning Mother... the group started to go crazy @ Monkey King.Tu Tu Gong: [@ Monkey King, stop hiding, I know you are online!】Yue Lao: 【Wukong, if you don’t come out again, I will tie a knot with a red thread!】Dian Mu: 【Don’t you believe me if I directly give you the Huaguoshan blackout message?] Wen Xuxu stared at the screen, seeing how lively the group was, and suddenly felt warm in her heart.At the same time, her curiosity was piqued.Will Monkey King, the Monkey King, who has never appeared in the group, pay attention to this little shrimp?Earth God: [This monkey is very playful, and even if you call him 800 times, you may not always pay attention to him.] Wen Xuxu was ready to wait for half an hour - but the next second.A voice from the "Monkey King" popped up.Wen Xuxu opened it with trembling fingertips.A metallic, ferocious and wild voice boomed in the bedroom: [Here comes my grandson!!!】This voice is full of energy!Wen Xuxu's phone was almost frightened.This voice... really sounds like the great sage in Journey to the West!He was dragged and beaten, and there was a bit of "I am the best in the world".Monkey King: [I just picked peaches in the peach garden and didn’t read the group messages.What's wrong?Who bullied our group?] Before Wen Xuxu had time to reply, Monkey King threw a glittering exclusive red envelope at her.She subconsciously clicked on it - four words popped up on the screen: [Three Monkey Hairs] Received.Three monkey hairs?Where is it?Wen Xuxu clicked around on the fairy group interface, then picked up her phone and looked at it carefully.There are really three monkey hairs!I saw that there were really three golden monkey hairs on the back of her originally bare transparent shell.Thin, soft, and glowing beautifully under the light.Wow, these are the peripherals of Monkey King!!!Monkey King: [Girl, you have collected these three monkey hairs.] Monkey King: [Each time you use one, you can summon me, Old Sun, to possess you once.Each possession lasts for a full day in your mortal world.] Wen Xuxu stared at the three golden monkey hairs, her eyes widened.Summon Sun Wukong to possess you?one day?Her mind was already racing - if she met a bad guy, let the Great Sage get on top of him, not to mention a few gangsters, even a car wouldn't be enough to fight him.Monkey King: [But there is a condition. When I am possessed, you must cooperate with me in whatever I want to do.For example, if you do somersaults, do a golden cudgel, etc., don't stop them.】 Wen Xuxu’s fingers almost pressed the phone’s keyboard to make smoke: 【Of course!!!] What is the concept of being possessed by the Monkey King?This is the master who is causing trouble in the Heavenly Palace!The kind where one person can challenge hundreds of thousands of heavenly soldiers and generals!Who will you be afraid of when you go out in the future?She rolled over on the bed with excitement, and then quickly typed: Wen Xuxu: [Thank you, Great Sage!What should I offer you?What do you want to eat?Peach?Banana crisp?How can I send it to you?】 Monkey King: 【 Offer?There's no need to fix the empty ones.] Wen Xuxu was stunned, thinking that the Great Sage was so polite?The next second, a message popped up: Monkey King: [Girl, you call me now, immediately, immediately, with a monkey hair.] Wen Xuxu:???The great sage came so quickly.Is this the legendary "Monkey Urgency"?Wen Xuxu: [Now?] Could it be that the Great Sage is aware of any danger around him?!Monkey King: [Yes!Right now!Hurry!] Monkey King: [I, Sun, must personally check to see if there is any danger around you.With my sharp eyes, I can't hide any troubles within a hundred miles!] Wen Xu immediately became serious: [Okay!】The Great Sage is worthy of being a Great Sage, with superb execution ability!Wen Xuxu followed the summoning method described by Sun Wukong, picked up a piece of golden monkey hair, and rubbed it in his palm.The moment he rubbed his palms until they felt slightly warm - Wen Xuxu's head suddenly felt dizzy.For a moment, she felt like she had taken a high-speed elevator. Her eyesight went dark for a moment, and then lightened up again.Then, a strange feeling came up from the soles of his feet.It's not uncomfortable, it's like... something has penetrated into my body.But that feeling only lasted two or three seconds and disappeared quickly.Instead, there is something unprecedented - full power.Wen Xuxu jumped up from the bed, jumped twice on the spot, and spun around again.There was endless energy all over my body, as if I had just drank three bottles of Red Bull.She couldn't help but scratch her cheek, then scratched the back of her head, and then found that she couldn't stop at all - her hands seemed to have their own ideas and kept moving, as if she had ADHD.Wen Xuxu quickly spoke: "Great Sage? Great Sage, are you here?" "Do you sense any danger around me?" As soon as he finished speaking, a savage and wild voice sounded in his mind: "Don't worry, I, Old Sun, are scanning." "Well... there is someone eating in the villa next to you.The skewers are delicious for late night snacks." "There are two little fat cats downstairs who are in love.The male one has been courting him for a long time, but the female one has ignored him at all and even slapped him."... Wen Xuxu: "..." Monkey King, aren't your fiery eyes a bit too narrow?The Great Sage controlled Wen Xuxu's body and jumped up and down in a circle in the three-story villa.Look left, look right.Then, he sat down on the bed, crossed his legs, and made a "That's it?" expression on Wen Xuxu's face: "Girl, your room is too empty, there is not even a stick, and I can't find a guy even if I want to play with you." Wen Xuxu immediately said: "Buy! Buy it tomorrow! Everything from iron, wood, gold, and titanium alloys is arranged!" "Then what do you mortals usually play with?" The Great Sage scratched his chin.Wen Xuxu picked up the phone and shook it: "Play with this, play with the phone!" The Great Sage came over and stared at the screen for a long time: "Is this the little square you use to communicate with heaven? Besides sending messages to the group of gods, what else can you do?" Wen Xuxu: "You can watch dramas and listen to songs., can play games - by the way, those short dramas posted in the group are just for watching." The great sage waved his hands and said with a look of disgust: "Drama?I don't like that, the romance is boring, and the fun dramas are not interesting enough." Wen Xuxu felt it was very reasonable.Who is the Great Sage?Havoc in the Heavenly Palace, seventy-two transformations, and a character who is thousands of miles away.The life of the great sage itself is the most enjoyable article. It is enough to read his own stories. Why do you need to read those made by others?Wen Xuxu couldn't help but imagine the way the great sage watched the "Mortal World" drama - the protagonist on the screen shouted "I want to defy heaven", and the great sage was eating melon seeds beside him and rolled his eyes: "against heaven?"I, Lao Sun, have leaked everything.The villain on the screen was showing off, and the Great Sage sneered: That's it?My grandson can kill a dozen with one stick.Wen Xuxu quietly recovered her thoughts and came to the conclusion: The Great Sage didn't watch the drama because he didn't like the plot.Wen Xuxu suddenly remembered something and his eyes lit up.
